drawings.description: En marge gauche, un petit dessin : une tache marquée $J_0$ entourée de points, et un point $j$ à côté, sous le mot \uncertain{« partie »}.
drawings.kind: blob J_0 surrounded by points, and a point j
drawings.notes: A closed blob with a few points inside, a point j beside it, scattered points around; the label J_0 stands at the left, under the line. The word above ("partie", uncertain in the transcription) is text and not drawn. The sheet is a dark photocopy.

drawings.description: En haut à droite, de sa main, « S ». Sous ce titre de l'éditeur, deux dessins. À gauche, un disque épais : au centre un point $\Sigma_0$, d'où part un rayon marqué $c_{01}$ ; sur le bord, les arcs $\Sigma_{02}$ (en haut), $\Sigma_{012}$ (deux fois), $\Sigma_{01}$ ; hors du disque partent vers la droite trois demi-droites parallèles marquées $\Sigma_{12}$, $\Sigma_1$, $\Sigma_{12}$, et au-dessus de tout, $\Sigma_2$. À droite, un petit graphe de cinq points reliés par des flèches, sans légende lisible.
drawings.kind: thick disk with boundary arcs and rays; small graph of five points
drawings.notes: Left: a thick disk (outer circle heavy, inner circle thin), centre Sigma_0 with a radius c_01, boundary labels Sigma_02 (top), Sigma_012 (twice), Sigma_01, three parallel rays to the right labelled Sigma_12, Sigma_1, Sigma_12, and Sigma_2 above. Right: five points joined by strokes, two with arrowheads, meeting at a small open point; the marks "1'" and a stroke at its left are drawn, nothing else is readable; his "S" above it. Two marks at the far left of the sheet (a "d"-like sign and a downward stroke) are left out.

figures.what: thick disk with arcs and rays

drawings.description: À droite, un croquis : un coin de carré (deux axes), une courbe au-dessus et une demi-droite hachurée issue du sommet.
drawings.kind: corner of a square with a curve and a hatched half-line
drawings.notes: Two axes forming a corner, a wavy curve above joining their ends (doubled in places), and a half-line from the vertex with hatching beneath it.

drawings.description: Croquis de sa main : les traits verticaux portent le signe d'ordre (couché), les flèches horizontales ont une pointe à chaque bout, et deux traits partent de $i$ vers $j'$ et vers $k$.
drawings.kind: order diagram j', j, k', k, i
drawings.notes: j' <-> j above, k' <-> k below (two-headed arrows), the vertical strokes between them carrying the order sign lying on its side, and two strokes from i to j' and to k. The small word under the upper arrow is left out (not in the transcription).
